messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} I've got
a favor to ask you...

{07 0b 00}Would you deliver this
letter to {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00} for
me, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}It needs to get there
pretty fast, {07 16 00}so I can't use
the {ff 00 00 08}post office{ff 00 00 00}, you know?

{07 00 00}Hei, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} Mul on

{07 0b 00}Kas sa viiksid selle kirja
{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00} juurde minu

{07 00 00}Hey, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00} I'm sorry

have to get it over to
